objects.name: Analytic 2162
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process sending User Datagram Protocol (UDP) broadcast packets to Industrial Control System (ICS) discovery addresses from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with any recognized ICS commissioning tool. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
